description.value: Mükasi Coffee Roasters is a North Vancouver–based specialty coffee roaster offering a range of single-origin and blended whole-bean coffees sourced from Ethiopia, Vietnam, Guatemala, Honduras, and Indonesia. Their lineup spans bold espresso blends to delicate floral washed naturals, with an emphasis on traceable origins and cupping notes. The business operates an active online store with local delivery and Canada-wide shipping.
